keyFindings.description: `grow` on the details rail splits the row's free space with the title below xl (the title is flex-1, basis 0%, min 12rem), so at 1040-1279px with a short details line the title is squeezed and clamped where main showed it in full. Probe with the exact classes at 1024px: title block 203px and clamped with grow, 406px and fully visible without; at 1200-1279 with the real rail ~260-300px vs ~330-410px. grow is not needed for the scroll container (min-w-0 + shrink + overflow-x-auto verified at 390/1280/1536 without it). Fix: drop `grow`.

`failed = githubReference.isError || checks.isError` drops an already-loaded PR title and state when only the check-runs query fails, degrading to `#N owner/repo` with the raw URL as tooltip. Gate `reference` on githubReference.isError only; gate the checks pill on checks.isError. Requested in the same push; not blocking on its own.

`Route:` caption stays alone on the details line while the route form is open below; focus drops to body when the trigger unmounts. Hide the group while editing and focus the input on mount. Fast-follow acceptable.
